name: Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-SL45 'Kingmaker'
description:
The Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-SL45 is the heavy-caliber variant of the ARC smart-linked platform, chambered in .45 ACP with full BCI integration and an onboard threat assessment system that goes beyond simple ballistic calculation. The weapon's AI-assisted targeting identifies and prioritizes targets based on threat posture, weapon signature, and behavioral analysis — feeding the shooter a ranked engagement queue through their neural interface.

The Kingmaker is not just a smart gun — it is a tactical decision-support system in a pistol chassis. The threat assessment AI monitors a 180-degree forward arc through the weapon's integrated sensor suite, classifying individuals as non-threat, potential threat, or active threat in real time. The shooter sees this classification overlaid on their visual field, with the highest-priority target highlighted. The system can even suggest optimal shot placement based on detected armor coverage.

This level of autonomous threat analysis in a sidearm is controversial even within Arcturus. Internal documents leaked two years ago revealed heated debate among the design team about whether the system's target prioritization constituted an autonomous weapons system — a classification that would trigger international prohibitions. Arcturus maintains that the AI advises but never controls the trigger, a distinction that regulators have so far accepted.
legality: Restricted — requires Tier 5 security clearance, BCI registration, and autonomous systems waiver
specifications:
caliber: .45 ACP
effective_range: 60 meters (smart-linked)
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 10 rounds
weight: 1.08 kg
BCI_latency: <5ms
threat_classification_cycle: 200ms
tactical_use: An AI-assisted smart-linked combat pistol for elite operators facing complex multi-threat engagements. The threat prioritization system reduces decision-making overhead in chaotic environments, allowing the shooter to process and engage threats faster than unassisted cognition allows. The system is only as good as its threat classification — misidentification is rare but catastrophic when it occurs.
cultural_context: The Kingmaker is one of the most expensive sidearms in existence and is carried exclusively by Spire-level security professionals. Its existence is well known but rarely seen — most people in GLMZ will never encounter one outside of news coverage. The ethical debate surrounding its AI system has made it a focal point for both weapons-rights advocates and autonomous-systems critics.
known_users: Arcturus Defense Solutions senior field operatives
Rumored to be carried by certain government-level officials
story_hooks: A Kingmaker's threat assessment AI classifies a seemingly innocent bystander as the highest-priority threat in a crowded room — and the AI turns out to be right, but the reason why reveals something the players weren't supposed to know.

An Arcturus engineer has found a way to remotely update the Kingmaker's threat classification database — meaning someone could theoretically reclassify any person as a high-priority threat in every Kingmaker simultaneously.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, purposeful sidearm with an aggressively angular profile. The Kingmaker reads as predatory intelligence made metal—a compact service pistol retrofitted with visible sensor arrays and neural interface ports. Its silhouette is distinctly modern corporate-military: sharp lines, forward-weighted, bristling with discrete tech nodes.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 19.5 cm | Height: 13.2 cm (with rail mounts) | Width: 3.8 cm at slide | Barrel length: 10.2 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty but balanced. At 1.08 kg, it carries authority in the hand without fatigue during extended operations. The weight distribution favors the grip, lending stability to BCI-assisted targeting. Feels engineered rather than organic.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer frame with hardened steel slide. Barrel and internal mechanisms are chrome-moly steel. Integral rail system is CNC-machined aluminum. Grip panels are carbon-fiber composite.
physical_description.finish: Matte carbon-black slide with brushed gunmetal accents. Polymer frame is charcoal with subtle grip texturing. Rail mounts show anodized aluminum sheen. Subtle wear on contact points suggests this is a field weapon, not a showpiece.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal black and gunmetal grey with discrete matte silver sensor housing. Minimal branding. Accent lighting: soft amber LED indicators along the top rail and trigger guard (dormant until powered).
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured carbon-fiber with micro-ridged grip panels. The trigger guard has a knurled, almost scratchy finish to prevent slip during augmented-hand operation. Backstrap is stippled polymer—aggressive, military-grade.
distinctive_features: Integrated sensor pod atop the slide (approximately 4cm, flush-mounted aluminum housing with discrete optical windows)
BCI neural interface port: recessed gold-contact array on the right side of the frame, just below the slide release
Threat assessment indicator lights along top rail—three amber LEDs (dormant until BCI link activates)
Enhanced trigger guard with tactical grooves for augmented fingers
Top rail features custom Picatinny mounts with integrated fiber-optic data conduits (barely visible, recessed)
Magazine well has subtle depth indicators etched in silver
Serial plate on left side of frame: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo flanked by manufacturing codes
Wear patterns: slight scuff marks on polymer frame corners, micro-scratches on slide from field use, faint discoloration on magazine well from sustained contact
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Left side of frame bears embossed Arcturus Defense Solutions shield logo (0.8cm height) with production year below. Serial number stamped on right side of frame. Blackwood Commercial Group sub-brand marking appears as small text above trigger guard. No flashy branding—designed to be recognizable to operators, anonymous to civilians.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but operationally weathered. This is a working combat platform kept in field condition—clean internals, no cosmetic padding. Evidence of regular use: worn grip edges, faint salt-staining on polymer from sweat/environment, micro-dings on slide rails. The sensor pod shows minor dust accumulation in corners. Kept functional over pristine.
